headline: UK regulators state existing rules apply to personal AI agents
summary: On 30 October 2026, the UK Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum’s four member regulators—the CMA, FCA, ICO and Ofcom—issued a joint statement on personal AI agents. They said existing competition, consumer, data-protection, online-safety, financial-services, payments and cybersecurity frameworks apply, and described ongoing coordination, engagement with firms, guidance, intelligence sharing and regulatory sandboxes. The statement does not create a new legal duty or provide final agent-specific rules, a named enforcement action or measured implementation results.
